program.major: Human Developmental Sciences with a Specialization in Healthy Aging

notes: 8 lower-division (32 units) + 13 upper-division (56 units) courses. The specialization mirrors the traditional B.S., with 3 of the 13 upper-division courses focused on aging, one of which must be a Project on Aging inside a practicum. All major coursework must be taken for a letter grade with a C- or better. HDS 1, 150, 181 and 191 must be taken in residence. Harvested from the HDS program's own Healthy Aging requirement page, cross-checked against catalog.ucsd.edu/curric/HDS.html.

buckets.label: Statistics (1 of)
buckets.note: Students who declared the HDS major Fall 2021 or later must take HDS 60. Earlier declarations may use PSYC 60, COGS 14B or MATH 11.

buckets.label: Formal skills (2 of)
buckets.note: Either two courses from the MATH 10 or MATH 20 sequence, or one of those math courses plus one programming course (CSS 1, CSE 7, CSE 8A, CSE 11).

buckets.label: Biological sciences (2 of)
buckets.note: BILD 38 used here cannot also count toward the Healthy Aging specialization coursework.

buckets.label: Social sciences (2 of)
buckets.note: Only one of HILD 7A/7B/7C may be used.

buckets.label: Core Domain 2A — Social-cognitive development (1 of)
buckets.note: HDS 121 and COGS 110 are the same course, cross-listed.

buckets.label: Development Domain 2 — Cognitive and language development (1 of)
buckets.note: LIGN 119 and EDS 119 are the same course, cross-listed.

buckets.label: Development Domain 3 — Socio-cultural development (1 of)
buckets.note: PH 110 and PH 120 were previously FMPH 110 / FMPH 120. SOCI 159 counts only when the quarter's topic is approved for the HDS major. EDS 117/SOCI 117 and SOCI 116/LIGN 174 are cross-listings.

buckets.label: Methods: HDS 181
buckets.note: Prereqs: HDS 1, statistics, and three upper-division HDS major courses (one per domain). Department approval to enroll; must be taken in residence.

buckets.label: Methods: HDS 191
buckets.note: Prereq: HDS 181, plus a pre-enrollment questionnaire submitted one academic year ahead. With an approved aging-focused site placement, HDS 191 also satisfies the Healthy Aging Practicum Project.

buckets.label: Healthy Aging coursework (2 of)
buckets.note: Specialization requirement. BILD 38 counts here only if it was not used for the lower-division biological sciences requirement. BIMM 128 requires a petition.

buckets.label: Methods elective / Healthy Aging practicum (1 of)
buckets.note: The Healthy Aging Practicum Project is done either here — through an approved aging project in USP 141/141A, HDS 193 or HDS 194B — or through an aging-focused HDS 191 placement. Students who use HDS 191 for the practicum still owe a methods elective, and may then use any course on this list.

buckets.label: Senior seminar capstone: HDS 150
buckets.note: Prereqs: HDS 181, senior standing, department approval. Must be taken in residence.
